11six24-pegasus-jelly-bean-2: Soft, dense feel with quick hands and easy dinks; some find put-away power modest.
11six24-ultre-jelly-bean-2: Plush control on dinks, drops and resets, but a few found it head heavy and slow in hand battles.
11six24-ultre-power-2: Spin, pop and a large sweet spot; a good number find the feel stiff and muted.
11six24-vapor-power: Easy power and a big sweet spot with little adjustment; some found the stiff feel hard on the arm.
11six24-vapor-power-2: Durable grit gives plenty of spin, but dead spots along the top edge are a common complaint.
bread-butter-loco-hybrid: Heavy spin and fast hands for attackers, though the pop makes dinks and resets hard for some.
crbn2-trufoam-genesis: Spin and a big sweet spot with a dense feel; the main complaint is durability, with a few rattling.
crbn3-trufoam-genesis: Dense, consistent feel for an easy soft game, though many find it head heavy and short on power.
enhance-duo: Control, spin and a big sweet spot, and several own the widebody as their main paddle.
honolulu-j6cr: Spin and pop with a big sweet spot; the grit is inconsistent and wore smooth within months for some.
luzz-cannon: Often compared favourably with a Joola Perseus Pro IV for less; the power can be hard to control.
pickleball-apes-pulse: Soft control on drops and dinks that improves after break-in; several report core crush.
ronbus-quanta-r3-16: Great-value power and pop that works best with weight added; edge guards coming loose is the gripe.
ronbus-quanta-r4-16: Fast in the hands with plenty of power, but it feels light stock and edge guards come loose.
rpm-jade-elongated: Softer feel with easy drops and dinks, though a few were lukewarm on its power next to the Ultré.
six-zero-black-opal-14mm: Easy power and spin for centred hits; the small sweet spot makes resets and volleys tougher.
six-zero-coral-16mm: Forgiving resets and dinks for players leaving poppier paddles; edge guards separating is the gripe.
six-zero-coral-pro-16mm: Spin-friendly grit that lasts and suits kitchen players; many report dead spots near the top.
six-zero-ruby: Plush feel with easy resets and dinks; the main gripe is grit wearing smooth after several months.
spartus-spitfire-elongated: Spin and drive power, and many call it their main paddle; some find it too poppy for touch shots.
vatic-pro-prism-flash: Soft, forgiving first paddle at a low price, but it lacks power and the grit wears off in months.
vatic-pro-saga: Plush, Prism-like feel with more power; a couple found it weak or nothing special.
vatic-pro-v-sol-pro: Budget paddle with good control and easy pop, a clear step up on the Prism Flash; the grit fades.
vatic-pro-v-sol-tour: Spin, power and pop, a step up from the V-Sol Pro; many saw the face go smooth within weeks.
six-zero-double-black-diamond-control: Control and fast hands with good resets and dinks; some struggle with pop-ups and long balls.
spartus-apollo: Most rave about its spin; a few report loose edge guards or a broken handle.
11six24-pegasus-power-2: Strong pop and spin from a gritty surface; it can be too poppy or stiff for some.
11six24-hurache-x-power: Power and pop with decent control, but the most repeated complaint is a stiff, boardy feel.
11six24-vapor-alpha-pro-power: Plusher than the original Vapor Power; the clear downside is core crush for a few.
six-zero-ruby-pro-14mm: Grit and a dink-friendly feel, but the most repeated complaint is a lack of power.
11six24-pegasus-power: Forgiving and light with fast hands; some found it stiff or too poppy.
crbn1-trufoam-genesis: Control, spin and power; durability is the main concern, with a couple breaking after months.
bread-butter-loco-standard: Power with soft touch at the kitchen; some find it stiff, hollow or loud.
11six24-vapor-jelly-bean-2: A couple still love it, but others report dead top corners and a hard-to-find sweet spot.
11six24-pegasus-jelly-bean: Control, a forgiving sweet spot and good dinking; a couple find it weak on hard drives.
bread-butter-loco-elongated: Many say its power and control come alive with added weight; a few report lost grit.
crbn4-trufoam-genesis: Quick, manoeuvrable hands and a good soft game at the kitchen.
enhance-sweetspot-pro: More spin and forgiveness for players moving up from cheap paddles, though not a power paddle.
enhance-mpp-turbo: Strong value at about $100, but several report faces bubbling or separating.
engage-alpha-pro: Powerful yet consistent on drops and resets.
gearbox-pro-ultimate-hyper-16mm: Soft and quick in hand, with somewhat less power than other Gearbox models.
gearbox-gx2-power-hybrid: Power and control with good spin; some needed warranty replacements for cracks or bubbles.
gearbox-pro-ultimate-elongated-16mm: Easier for dinks and resets than the Pro Power; a couple find it heavy and slow.
joola-hyperion-pro-iv: Power, control and a good sweet spot that several say holds up after months.
honolulu-j2cr: Spin and a large, forgiving sweet spot, but the grit went smooth quickly on some units.
joola-agassi-pro: Hand speed and a tennis-friendly shape, but many report core crush or dead areas within months.
joola-scorpeus-pro-iv: Several name it a favourite or main paddle; a couple report problems.
joola-scorpeus-3s: Pop and soft-game control; a couple report it crunching after heavy play.
paddletek-bantam-esq-c: Forgiving at 14.3 and fast at 12.7; a few found a small sweet spot or dead spots.
luzz-pro-4-inferno: Pop, power and a forgiving feel, but several report dead faces and delamination.
pickleball-apes-harmony: Soft-feeling, manoeuvrable all-court paddle that is low on power.
prokennex-black-ace-pro: A couple say it let them keep playing through tennis elbow; a few report dimples in the face.
pakle-fuse-hybrid-w: Soft and hollow once broken in, with easy dinks and resets; reviews are split on power.
proton-series-four-project-roadrunner: Fast hands, spin and a controlled feel, though several find it short on pop.
ronbus-quanta-r1-16: Mostly liked, though several describe adding weight, and one found it unforgiving without it.
rpm-q2-elongated: Poppy and powerful stock; several added weight for stability or extra punch.
selkirk-labs-project-boomstik-widebody: Very powerful and poppy; a couple find dinks and soft shots harder to dial in.
spartus-spitfire-widebody: Quick hands at the kitchen, spin and a forgiving face; a couple note a hollow sound.
